# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos gives the final plan no independent existence, only service;
Awtsmoos.com receives each small rewrite as a clearer vessel with less conflict at the surface.

## Files to read before Rebbe writes

- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/index.html`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/style.css`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/styles/main.css`

## First execution sequence

1. Rerun Comment Thread complete suite and source gates.
2. If green, update REMAINING_WORK to close Comment Thread.
3. Build Rebbe import/ownership graph and current Git ownership.
4. Select the smallest proven Rebbe defect cluster for the first code-first wave.
5. Rewrite whole files only; split new responsibilities below 120 lines.
6. Complete code before running tests.
7. Run structural gates, then focused tests, then broader tests.
8. Perform route-load/mobile proof through available browser/server surfaces.
9. Re-read all touched files and compare planned vs actual.
10. Update REMAINING_WORK and continue to the next unresolved route.
